requirements.text: Write a Python module `slug.py` with a function `slugify(title)`.
Convert ASCII uppercase letters to lowercase; keep ASCII letters and digits.
Every maximal run of other characters (spaces, punctuation, non-ASCII letters such as é) becomes a single `-`.
Remove any `-` at the start or end of the result.
Return the slug as a string; it is "" when the title has no ASCII letters or digits.

import re
import string

_LOWER = str.maketrans(string.ascii_uppercase, string.ascii_lowercase)
_RUN = re.compile("[^a-z0-9]+")


def slugify(title):
    text = title.translate(_LOWER)
    return _RUN.sub("-", text).strip("-")

validations.evidence: 5 requirements hold
translate of ASCII uppercase then collapsing non-alphanumeric runs gives the same slugs.
